widgets_values: Playful children's fashion magazine cover, bright happy storybook mood. Sky-blue backdrop with a lush green grass field in front. A giant fluffy apricot-and-cream CAT sits behind a young model, huge round amber eyes, tiny pink nose, thick soft fur, wearing a daisy chain collar with a little red bow, one big paw resting in the grass, tail curled up, friendly and silly. The model is a young woman with short curly ginger hair and freckles, wearing oversized butter-yellow and sky-blue patchwork quilted overalls over a striped tee, red rain boots with white toes, and a crocheted bucket hat with tiny mushroom charms; she leans back on one leg, laughing, one hand holding a red balloon on a string. Storybook props around them: giant white mushrooms with big yellow polka dots, enormous white daisies with orange centres, chunky blue pompom flowers, a tall green cactus with red flowers on the left, purple bellflowers on the right, little red poppies, a few floating soap bubbles, and a small orange snail on a leaf. Bright even daylight, juicy saturated colour, printed paper grain, hand-made collage feel. Typography: giant cream didone serif masthead reading 'IDEOGRAM' across the very top, letters bleeding off the top and both side edges. Tiny cream caps under it on the left: 'NOVEMBER 2026  VOL 4.6'. Left side serif italic cream cover line: 'Silly Little Prompts', with small caps under it 'TEXT TO IMAGE'. Right side small cream caps stacked: 'NATIVE 4K' then 'PRECISE EDITS'. Bottom edge centred serif italic cream: 'Say it out loud. Watch it appear.' Bottom left a small barcode. Clean legible typography, no overlapping letters, no real world brand logos or trademarks, no watermark.
